subject: QBR orientation: launch tailwinds, failpoints, and OKR readiness
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Acme Analytics <ops@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: QBR orientation: launch tailwinds, failpoints, and OKR readiness

Team —

Heading into QBR prep next week I want a short, pragmatic snapshot that we can use to anchor the exec discussion. Goal is a one-slide status per top product initiative and a concise risk strip for the launch timelines. Please send updates by EOD Wednesday with the following: 

1) One-line tempo: on-plan / at-risk / slipping + expected delta (days)
2) Top 2 technical risks that would materially change the launch date
3) Mitigation in flight and required leadership asks (if any)
4) Link to the working artifact (drive or ticket)

I've attached a draft orientation deck and a simple CSV (roadmap-failpoints.csv) you can add rows to. Keep bullets terse. We may push a few asks to the SLT for runway and prioritization.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: qbr-orientation-deck-v1.pptx (pptx), roadmap-failpoints.csv (csv)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR orientation: launch tailwinds, failpoints, and OKR readiness

Hannah — quick notes from my side for the executive slide: 

- Model serving scale (Core API v2): at-risk — expected delta ~10 days if current infra depletion continues. Root cause: unexpected memory fragmentation on T4 pool during long-run tests.
- KV cache-backed prefix caching (Optimize): on-plan — still green for Q3 launch.

Top mitigations: temporary capacity bump to mitigate risk (ops-led), and an infra rollback plan ready if perf regressions reappear. Leadership ask: approve $60k short-term burst reserve (2 weeks).

I'll drop a short row in the CSV and link the perf test run artifacts.

— Vivek
VP, Engineering

On Tue, May 11, 2027 at 09:13 AM PDT, Hannah Schmitt wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Heading into QBR prep next week I want a short, pragmatic snapshot...
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR orientation: launch tailwinds, failpoints, and OKR readiness

Hannah — added my rows. Quick summary on product-side impacts: 

- Hosted API: on-plan for the scope we committed; customer-facing rate-limiter changes are in review and block a couple of lower-priority integrations (no timeline slip).
- Dedicated offering (reserved pools): at-risk — dependencies on partner billing integration (SaaSCo) may push contract-driven launches by ~3 weeks. Procurement is looping their PM.

Risks I flagged in the CSV: partner billing API version mismatch; regression on streaming QoS under long sessions (we have a mitigation branch but it's unvalidated). Ask: product needs a one-week validation window and sign-off to freeze the billing contract interface.

Irene
Director, Product Management

On Wed, May 12, 2027 at 08:47 AM PDT, Vivek Kulkarni wrote:
> Hannah — quick notes...
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example.com>, Vivek Kulkarli <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 10:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR orientation: launch tailwinds, failpoints, and OKR readiness

Quick operational notes from engineering: 

- Member rollout automation (shiproom): slipping — 14-day delta because of test flakiness in canary harness. Root cause: intermittent race in KV cache warmup.
- Workaround: gated rollout with manual verification steps; long-term: fix in the canary harness and add deterministic warmup.

I updated the CSV with the canary ticket (ENG-9421) and noted expected impact to OKR key results for adoption. If SLT wants to preserve the original adoption OKR target, we'll need to shift non-critical backlog out of this sprint.

Karthik
Sr Engineering Manager

On Thu, May 13, 2027 at 10:31 AM PDT, Irene Choi wrote:
> Hannah — added my rows...
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR orientation: launch tailwinds, failpoints, and OKR readiness

Added customer impact notes for Acme (they're in the thread as ops contact). TL;DR: Acme has two pilots that expect Dedicated capacity by June; if partner billing slips they may request a 30-day extension or delay the pilot. 

Proposed SLT asks for the QBR: 
- Approve two-week infra burst ($60k) to protect Core API v2 launch window
- Approve one-week validation window for billing contract freeze with SaaSCo
- Re-scope adoption OKR or authorize backlog shift if we want to preserve timeline

I'll sync with Acme offline today and push a short note to procurement & PM at SaaSCo.

Monica
Head of Customer Success

On Fri, May 14, 2027 at 09:05 AM PDT, Karthik Iyer wrote:
> Quick operational notes...
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>, Acme Analytics <ops@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR orientation: launch tailwinds, failpoints, and OKR readiness

Thanks everyone — this is exactly what we need. Next steps: 

- I'll consolidate the rows into the one-slide summary and circulate the QBR orientation deck by Monday morning.
- Vivek: please add the perf logs and exact dollar ask into the drive folder (see link).
- Irene: confirm gating/validation window for billing integration and get a nominal sign-off from SaaSCo PM (if they confirm today, we'll include it in the slide).
- Karthik: add the ENG-9421 remediation ETA to the ticket and mark the manual gating steps in the rollout runbook.
- Monica: share the Acme pilot contingency note (short email) and I'll include it as an appendix slide.

If anyone wants to flag a different ask for SLT, reply-all by EOD Monday.

Hannah
Director, Product Operations
